text: CEIC2026消费电子创新大会22日至24日在深圳举行。其间，工业互联网操作系统产业联盟在2026消费电子创新大会·具身智能产业论坛上成立。中国科学院沈阳自动化所研究员李庆鑫分享工业互联网操作系统技术架构。他表示，具身智能落地工厂，需要打通设计域-制造域、管理域-控制域两条业务链路，实现人、机、料、工艺、环境全要素集成。工业互联网操作系统需要满足跨域跨平台设计、任务可信运行、模型迁移一致性、多硬件设备适配四大核心需求。（中新网）
text_en: The CEIC 2026 Consumer Electronics Innovation Conference was held in Shenzhen from the 22nd to the 24th. During the event, the Industrial Internet Operating System Industry Alliance was established at the Embodied Intelligence Industry Forum of the 2026 Consumer Electronics Innovation Conference. Li Qingxin, a researcher at the Shenyang Institute of Automation of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, shared the technical architecture of industrial internet operating systems. He said that for embodied intelligence to be deployed in factories, two business links must be connected: the design domain-manufacturing domain link and the management domain-control domain link, achieving full-factor integration of people, machines, materials, processes and environment. Industrial internet operating systems need to meet four core requirements: cross-domain and cross-platform design, trusted task operation, model migration consistency, and adaptation to multiple hardware devices. (China News Service)
